create.name: Russill Paul
create.bio:
Russill Paul is a musician, author and teacher of the yoga of sound, the use of mantra, chant and music as a spiritual path. At nineteen he entered monastic life in South India under the English Benedictine Bede Griffiths, living as a monk at Saccidananda Ashram by the Kaveri river and studying meditation and mysticism with a number of teachers; Griffiths's meeting of Christian and Hindu contemplation runs through his work. He recorded sacred music in India, including film soundtracks, before moving to North America, where his chant albums and his book The Yoga of Sound, with its teaching CD, introduced many Western practitioners to the Vedic, Tantric, devotional and Nada streams of sacred sound. He later wrote Jesus in the Lotus on the common ground between Christianity and yoga.

Over more than three decades he has led workshops at Omega, Esalen, Kripalu and Hollyhock and taught at the California Institute of Integral Studies, among other colleges. These days most of his teaching runs through the online Yogic Mystery School he founded with his wife, Asha Paul, which offers self-paced courses in mantra, Sri Vidya Tantra, devotional singing and meditation, with monthly live sessions on Zoom. He also gives private spiritual coaching and trains coaches and teachers to bring contemplative practice into their own work.

books.title: The Yoga of Sound: Tapping the Hidden Power of Music and Chant
books.author: Russill Paul
books.description: A guide to sacred sound in the Indian traditions, from Vedic mantra and Tantric practice to devotional chant and listening for inner sound, with exercises for bringing these practices into a Western life.

courses.title: Yoga of Sound Immersion
courses.description: His recommended starting point: self-paced online groundwork across the Vedic, Tantric, Bhakti and Nada approaches to sacred sound, each working on a different side of voice and awareness.

courses.title: Mastery of Mantra
courses.description: A training in Vedic mantra and correct Sanskrit pronunciation for teachers and practitioners who want to chant with precision, with master classes and an optional coached six-month process.
courses.price: $295 USD per month, or $1,500 USD for six months

courses.title: Mantra Master Classes
courses.description: Online classes on what Vedic, Tantric and devotional mantras are for and how to chant them, at self-directed, interactive or privately coached levels.

courses.title: The Secret Life
courses.description: A course for experienced meditators that moves past technique into Gnostic and mystical approaches to inner life, drawn from his years as a monk.

courses.title: Sri Vidya Immersion
courses.description: An introduction to Sri Vidya, the goddess-centred path that combines yoga and mantra from the Vedic, Tantric and devotional streams, taught without sectarian framing.

courses.title: Private Coaching Session with Russill Paul
courses.description: A one-to-one session on Zoom, recorded for you, to work on mantra, Tantra or meditation practice or on bringing spiritual coaching into your work. Booking one also opens a period of access to a course intensive.

courses.title: Spiritual Coaching Packages
courses.description: One- and three-month coaching packages that pair private sessions with access to a Yogic Mystery School course, shaped around inner life, relationships or your work.
